facts.fact: The European Investment Bank (EIB Global, European Union) announced a $100 million financing to AXIAN Telecom for 4G and 5G rollout, of which $40 million goes to Madagascar and $60 million to Tanzania; the document is dated 11 April 2025 and reports an announcement of 10 April 2025.
facts.system: EIB financing to AXIAN Telecom for 4G/5G
